definition: A person or team of no more than five full-time-equivalent workers that has economic control of the app, owns or controls the IP and revenue rights, and is not controlled by a parent company, public company, client, employer, or institutional investor. Contractors are allowed.
analytic_note: Primary analytical population; tighter than “small developer.”

definition: A publisher with no more than 10 FTEs and less than $1 million of trailing-12-month gross app revenue, with no controlling parent.
analytic_note: Broader than independent; includes small funded companies.

definition: A native or hybrid iOS or Android product whose primary user is an individual consumer. Excludes internal enterprise tools, client-owned apps, mobile web products, and apps that merely facilitate physical-goods sales.
analytic_note: Keeps app economics distinct from commerce enabled by an app.

definition: An app that is available and functional and either was updated in the prior 24 months or had a substantive usage, search, download, rating, or review signal in the prior 12 months.
An app with a live monetization path, or documented external monetization attributable to the app.
analytic_note: Includes subscription, paid download, IAP, advertising, and commission models.

definition: An independent consumer app live for at least 90 days with functional monetization and at least one of: 1,000 lifetime installs; 10 ratings/reviews; $100 lifetime revenue; $500 launch or marketing spend; or 100 documented post-launch founder hours.
analytic_note: Excludes templates, tests, abandoned prototypes, brand companions, and client work.

definition: Trailing-30-day customer receipts attributable to digital app access or use, in-app advertising, or app-mediated commission, net of refunds and indirect tax but before platform/payment fees and operating costs.
analytic_note: The report’s default headline basis: gross revenue.

definition: The threshold is met in each of three consecutive calendar months.
analytic_note: Six-month persistence is shown as a sensitivity, not the default.

definition: Customer billings attributable to the app, net of refunds and indirect tax, before store/payment fees and operating costs.
analytic_note: Comparable to consumer spend only when tax/refund treatment is explicit.

definition: Gross revenue less app-store/payment fees and withholding, before hosting, APIs, support, contractors, acquisition, and personal tax.
analytic_note: Apple and Google also use “proceeds” or “earnings” in program-specific ways.

definition: Developer proceeds less hosting, APIs, support, contractors, paid acquisition, content, and tools. Founder labor and personal tax are excluded from accounting profit; an economic-profit sensitivity values founder labor at market rates.
analytic_note: Public revenue screenshots rarely establish profit.

definition: $5,000 per month of owner profit before personal tax.
